name: Room
lead: An isolated world with its own players and tables, from `rooms.create` or `rooms.main`.

functions.name: message
functions.description: This room's `world` table: its blocks, entities and displays. This room's `players` table; its `on_join` fires each time a player moves in. This room's `sound` table. This room's `fx` table. This room's `ui` table. This room's `game` table: the game version it runs, its entity kinds and blocks. This room's `commands` table. Sends a chat line to everyone in this room.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Takes the room away; players still in it keep the world. Does nothing to `rooms.main`.

fields.name: spawn_point
fields.description: The room's number. Rooms also compare by identity with `==`. Where players arrive in this room; writable. A write is not stored and does not move the chunks that stay loaded.

title: Room type
